text:
elaine: Quick check - final draft of the launch post is in the doc, want a rapid pass before I lock it for publish tomorrow morning. https://docs.google.com/draft/Redwood-Launch
sam: skimmed it - nice. two quick asks: make the hero a single sentence, and tighten the benchmark callout.
tariq: +1. For benchmarks we should call out P95 latency and the test setup. Suggest: "P95 latency of 95ms on a 1k token window (measured on Dedicated GPU pools)" - legal ok with that copy, @maria ?
maria: legal ok on that phrasing except avoid the word "always" anywhere. Also prefer "Dedicated GPU pools" for public copy.
jess: copy tweak suggestion for hero: current "Ship LLM features without the inference guesswork." -> "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and cost." shorter, clearer. Thoughts?
owen: I like the clarity. Also rethink CTA - instead of "Try Redwood" make it "Get a free performance audit" so we can route leads into webinar + Dedicated follow-up.
elaine: good call on CTA. Can we map inbound routing? propose: form -> tag as "launch-audit" in HubSpot, assign to PS queue for audit invites, and auto-enroll in the webinar nurture sequence.
sam: routing sounds right. @jess can you add the hidden field name and tag values for the form? we'll need it for the landing page build.
jess: hidden field = "lead_source" value = "launch_post_2026"; hubspot tag = "launch-audit"; nurture list = "webinar-audit-path". adding to doc now.
tariq: small note on benchmark wording: add a parenthetical about model/class used for the test, e.g., "representative 13B-class model" - keep it short.
maria: legal prefers no proprietary model names unless open-sourced. suggest: "representative 13B-class model" instead of explicit names.
elaine: ok use maria's wording. jess update paragraph to: "In internal benchmarks, Redwood delivered P95 latency of 95ms on a representative 13B-class model (1k tokens)."
jess: updated in doc and put a diff comment on the paragraph.
elaine: approvals - @maria legal ✅, @sam marketing ✅? ping product for tech accuracy too.
sam: marketing ✅. I'll ping product in #eng-ml for a quick technical check.
publish-bot: Reminder: draft scheduled for publish window 09:00 PT tomorrow if post-lock occurs by 18:00 PT today. Use /publish-lock to lock.
elaine: locking at 17:45 PT. last call for edits here. anything else?
tariq: small nit - add a sentence about rollout options (Hosted, Dedicated, Private) in the TL;DR so enterprise readers see fit.
jess: added a one-liner in the TL;DR.
owen: webinar logistics - we'll do 30-min demo + 15-min Q&A. propose 2 sessions (EMEA/APAC) and a follow-up on-demand asset.
elaine: love it. ops: can we capture preferred timezones on form for routing? jess added a "timezone" hidden field mapping to webinar sequence.
elaine: ok locking now. thanks everyone - I'll run the /publish-lock and send the prelaunch email to early adopters list.
sam: :thumbsup: nice work team.
publish-bot: publish-lock applied by elaine at 5112233401. Scheduled publish: 2026-05-18T16:00:00Z.
